steps.title: Skills
steps.content: Your basic building blocks. A Skill is a single reusable action, like generating a summary, parsing a document, or creating a ticket.

steps.title: Integrations
steps.content: Connect your app stack (Slack, Google Workspace, GitHub). Integrations grant your Skills permission to read and write data securely.

steps.title: Memory
steps.content: The central brain. Store brand guidelines, documentation, and context here so your agents stay informed on company policies and knowledge.

steps.title: Agents
steps.content: Your digital team members. An Agent combines multiple Skills and Memory into a dedicated role (e.g., Compliance Officer, Specs Builder).

steps.title: Automations
steps.content: Put work on autopilot. Set up schedule or event triggers (e.g., 'every Monday at 9 AM' or 'on new Slack tag') to run tasks automatically.

steps.title: Ask & Execute
steps.content: Type requests in plain English to invoke skills, query your Memory database, or run an agent directly from this prompt bar.

steps.title: Starting Points
steps.content: Browse ready-to-use templates grouped by Slack agents, internal apps, and data reports to launch workflows instantly.
